line_items.reasoning: Q1 operational sales growth of 6.4% came in above the guided full-year midpoint of 6.2%, and JNJ subsequently raised its full-year operational sales guidance range to 5.9%-6.9% (midpoint ~$100.2B), signaling Q1 results exceeded the prior trajectory.
JNJ raised its full-year adjusted EPS guidance by $0.02 to $11.30-$11.50 after Q1, indicating Q1 earnings performance came in ahead of the prior guided range of $11.28-$11.48.

Adjusted pretax operating margin compressed sharply from 36.6% to 32.5% year-over-year in Q1, driven by tariff impacts, heavier launch investment, and unfavorable mix — falling well short of the guidance for at least 50 bps of full-year margin improvement.

No Q1 free cash flow figure was explicitly reported against the ~$21B full-year target, and with guidance raised on the top and bottom line, FCF trajectory appears on track but cannot be confirmed as a beat or miss at this stage.
